notes.title: Delve deeper into the Land of the Immortals as the Immortal Saga continues!
notes.content:
[p]Deep within the Land of the Immortals, the mythical realm of Thera has returned from oblivion...
 
As adventurers from all over Dracania gather to explore the secrets of this barren wasteland, a dark secret that could change the foundations of the whole world is about to be unveiled.
 
Join the Order of the Griffon, return the legendary world tree Nefaraya back to life and discover a shocking conspiracy in the Shadow of the Immortals, as we delve deeper into the Immortal Saga!

With a brand-new Stellar Walker Set to kit out your hero, the new Cosmic Carpet mount as well as new Runes and Pets, you won’t want to miss out!

FREE VOUCHER CODE

To celebrate the start of this new adventure, we’ve created a special voucher for you. Simply redeem the code [b]NEFARAYA[/b] within the game and you’ll be rewarded 1x Nefaraya's Blessing Chest, 1x Dragon Blood Box and 499x Essence of Vigor. The code is valid until 29th September, 2025.[/p]

Obtain Ferry Tickets from worthy enemies throughout Dracania, complete daily quests to earn Solar Coins and increase your helper rank by earning Insignias of Helpfulness. With tons of great rewards to claim, Drakensang Online’s Summer Solstice is an event you won’t want to miss!

notes.title: Uncover the mystery of the missing essences in the Desert of Essences event.
notes.content:
Few other substances in Dracania are more powerful than the precious essences sold by merchants. In an unforeseen twist, essence stocks seem to have run dry! What happened? Thabo, the realm magician, sends you to search for clues as to why the supply of essences has run out. All information you find leads you to the mysterious ruins in the desert of Shanri-La. 

In Shanri-La, mighty essence vortices raze everything in their path. They have their sights set on the essence merchants in particular, who are making their way to Shanri-Li to put an end to things. Could this mysterious guild be responsible for the shortage of supplies? And what have they done to invoke such scorn from the essence vortices?

Discover the answers to these mysteries in the Desert of Essences event!

Season 3 of the Season Pass has arrived in Drakensang Online! Get ready for a brand-new season filled with exclusive rewards and even more ways to rack up Experience Points as you advance along your chosen Season Pass path - including an exciting update of the Ancestral Ruins, with a brand-new leaderboard and up to 100 levels you will want to explore!

notes.title: Delve into the Infested Sewers of Kingshill and save the city from devastation!
notes.content:
Strange things are afoot in the Sewers below Kingshill. Workers are not coming home, the ground is shaking, heroes are missing, and to make matters worse, a Death Worm has been spotted. Kingshill is in dire need of help, and only you can help!

This won’t be an easy task. The sewers are dark and filled to the brim with danger. Scout reports indicate multiple dangerous foes roaming the dark tunnels – some even accompanied by big rats. Imagine taming those rats and travelling Dracania’s hidden paths! An enterprising adventurer could surely take advantage of that, and the craftsmen of Kingshill could even improve on such a mount. The sewers are also said to be full of ancient and powerful runes, just waiting to be claimed. 

Will you survive long enough to reach the Death Worm and put an end to the threat? Will Kingshill still be standing when you’re done? Team up with your friends or go in alone, and brave the Infested Sewers of Kingshill!

notes.title: Season 2 has started –choose your path!
notes.content:
Drakensang Online presents Season 2 of the Season Pass! Season 2, packed full of exciting and exclusive rewards, boasts even more ways to earn Experience Points to help you progress along your chosen Season Pass track including the brand-new League of Fortune Hunters update as well as the Ancestral Ruins to explore once again.

In Season 2, complete missions and quests throughout the entire duration of the season and earn enough Experience Points to progress all the way up to level 60. Earn free rewards via the Free Pass track or choose to unlock the Gold Pass track and Red Pass track by purchasing them via our payment section for even greater rewards.

Calling all brave heroes - Kingshill needs you in our brand-new permanent update, the League of Fortune Hunters! Some of the most notorious criminals have escaped prison and gone on the run. Apparently, all of these miscreants were once involved in the same crime and for some time now, a rumor has been circulating that one of the artefacts purloined during said crime contains ultimate power - and the criminals will stop at nothing to gain it. Overwhelmed by this emergency, Chancelor Aylwin of Kingshill has decided to hire volunteers in order to help the city guard track down the criminals before it's too late. Take on the challenge and hunt down the criminal gang to earn great rewards and help further your progression in the Season Pass!

But that’s not all! Descend into the Ancestral Ruins once more! Eradicate powerful enemies and defeat the masters of each domain before advancing to the next floor and earning vital rewards as well as Experience Points for the Season Pass.

notes.title: Uncover the mystery of the missing essences in the Desert of Essences event.
notes.content:
Few other substances in Dracania are more powerful than the precious essences sold by merchants. In an unforeseen twist, essence stocks seem to have run dry! What happened? Thabo, the realm magician, sends you to search for clues as to why the supply of essences has run out. All information you find leads you to the mysterious ruins in the desert of Shanri-La. 

In Shanri-La, mighty essence vortices raze everything in their path. They have their sights set on the essence merchants in particular, who are making their way to Shanri-Li to put an end to things. Could this mysterious guild be responsible for the shortage of supplies? And what have they done to invoke such scorn from the essence vortices?

Discover the answers to these mysteries in the Desert of Essences event!

Successful heroes will be rewarded with a selection of unique gemstones and festive goodies. If this is not enough, the much talked about magical cave will offer adventurers something new every day of the winter calendar during the Winter Solstice Event!

notes.title: Brand-new Season Pass!
notes.content:
A season of wonder has descended upon Dracania. Amidst these portents of a new age, powerful animal spirits have emerged from the Sea of Souls. Do you have the courage to tame these legendary mounts? Drakensang Online presents Season 1 of the Season Pass! 

Complete missions and quests to earn free rewards via the Free Pass or choose to unlock the Gold and Red Pass by purchasing them via our payment section for even greater rewards. This first ever iteration of the Season Pass features tons of exciting and exclusive rewards to get your hands on! Visit King Harold and discover the unique rewards that can be exchanged with Season Coins!

notes.title: Access a Drakensang Online account and sign-up to receive our newsletters!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a new feature that enhances the Drakensang Online experience for our Steam-registered players. With our latest system, you can now enjoy greater flexibility and exclusive benefits:

o	Dedicated DSO Account Access: Steam-registered players can now create a personal DSO account, allowing login through the DSO Client while still retaining the option to log in via Steam.

o	Email Registration for Newsletters: Once registered, you can sign up for our newsletters and receive bonus codes, game updates, and community news right in your inbox!

How to Set Up Your Drakensang Online account and newsletter subscription:

•	Log in via Steam as usual.
•	At the “Server Selection” page, click the “Connect” button.
•	Complete the “Connect Account” process and hit “Confirm Link” and you’re all set!

Please note: If you own a Steam account, after the account transfer you can only access the DSO shop via the Steam client and pay with Steam. Using other methods will result in an error.

notes.content: Descend into the Ancestral Ruins once again where thrilling new challenges await Dracania’s bravest heroes. Collect fragments to unlock the useful new Dragon Crest trinket and further enhance your character ready for battle. Discover the new Ancestral Items: Golden Goose Eggs, Filthy Oil Lamp, Dragon Egg Fossil, and a brand-new mount - the Forgotten Stone Man. What are you waiting for?

notes.title: The Ghost Festival has begun! Battle creepy monsters and save Duria once more!
notes.content:
For Oldfield it is the time of year to celebrate the yield of their beloved pumpkin fields by hosting their annual Ghost Festival. Everyone is in high spirits and ready to celebrate, until some sinister and haunting things start occurring in their usually peaceful village. Sophia, a village elder, seems to know more about these unsettling events and wants you to help her. In doing so, you might have to face horrendous events!

Are you brave enough to step into completely unknown lands filled with eerie ghosts and monsters to save Duria? Then take on the Return of the Dead challenge and win great rewards throughout the event including the brand-new Concentrated Autumn Rune for better speed, damage, and Andermant drop rate!

notes.title: Celebrate Drakensang Online’s 13th Dracanian Anniversary Festival!
notes.content:
Colorful banners are flying, fireworks brighten the sky, people are dancing everywhere – it can only mean one thing, the Dracanian Anniversary Festival is back! Visit Kingshill and take part in the greatest event in Dracania. 

But not everything is shining in the city! Somehow, Mortis, the God of Death has turned Kingshill's legendary Anniversary Eggs into ghostly spheres of spine-chilling terror. What kind of sorcery is this? No one really knows; but one thing is sure: NPC Yval Forsit is helping to defeat this evil plan. Purify the eggs with his help and get some incredible rewards in exchange!

Featuring new rewards, including new pets and mounts, a challenging new event map and much more, there’s plenty to help you celebrate Drakensang Online’s 13th Birthday event!

notes.title: Thwart the thieving Dark Dwarfs and reclaim the mines for the Spellweavers!
notes.content:
In a safely hidden mine, the Spellweavers are mining the ever-mysterious Viscanium. Should this mineral ever fall into the wrong hands, all of Dracania could be in grave danger. This is why only the most trusted of the First Circle have known of the mine’s whereabouts… until now! 

The Dark Dwarves set about building a secret Steamboat Harbor beneath the Viscanium mines and now have access to the precious mineral. Their plan is to steal the Viscanium, transport it to their Generatorium, and transform it into fuel for the war machines that are headed for Andrakasch!

Help Mud the Miner reclaim the mines by facing the sinister Dark Dwarves in their Steamboat Harbor. Incredible rewards, exceptional achievements, and thrilling adventures are waiting for those brave enough to face them during Drakensang Online’s Dark Dwarf Heist event!

notes.content:
It’s summer and what better way to celebrate than with the annual Summer Solstice Festival! Preparations have begun to make this year’s festival the most memorable yet. Enter Kalodoro, earn Solar Coins in the mini-games and check out the special Summer Solstice offers. Will you collect enough Summer Solstice Tokens to open the chests of the Melon Pug and the Summer Solstice Horse?

Once the preparations are over and the Summer Solstice Festival has begun, it’s your duty to help ensure the festival is a success! Obtain Ferry Tickets from worthy enemies throughout Dracania, complete daily quests to earn Solar Coins and increase your helper rank by earning Insignias of Helpfulness. With tons of great rewards to claim, Drakensang Online’s Summer Solstice is an event you won’t want to miss!

notes.title: Introducing the brand-new Descent into the Ancestral Ruins event!
notes.content:
Hidden inside a mysterious painting, a strange portal to an Ancestral Ruin has appeared in the Church of Kingshill. Now, adventurers from all over Dracania have made their way to Duria's capital in search of fame and fortune. Join the fray and uncover the truth that lies beneath!
 
Descend ever deeper into the Ancestral Ruin and light torches to summon waves of enemies. Eradicate the fiends to earn victory medals which can be exchanged for special goods in the shop. The masters of each domain will only unveil themselves after you collect three Staffs of Plague. You will only be allowed to advance to the next floor once you defeat them.

Experience the Descent into the Ancestral Ruins, an exciting and highly challenging new event, the likes of which has never been seen before in Drakensang Online!

notes.title: Delve into the Infested Sewers of Kingshill and save the city from devastation!
notes.content:
Strange things are afoot in the Sewers below Kingshill. Workers are not coming home, the ground is shaking, heroes are missing, and to make matters worse, a Death Worm has been spotted. Kingshill is in dire need of help, and only you can help!

This won’t be an easy task. The sewers are dark and filled to the brim with danger. Scout reports indicate multiple dangerous foes roaming the dark tunnels – some even accompanied by big rats. Imagine taming those rats and travelling Dracania’s hidden paths! An enterprising adventurer could surely take advantage of that, and the craftsmen of Kingshill could even improve on such a mount. The sewers are also said to be full of ancient and powerful runes, just waiting to be claimed. 

Will you survive long enough to reach the Death Worm and put an end to the threat? Will Kingshill still be standing when you’re done? Team up with your friends or go in alone, and brave the Infested Sewers of Kingshill!

Only Drakensang Online’s most experienced heroes dare step up to the challenge in saving Dracania from the evil Dragan! Team up with fellow champions or be a brave lone warrior in Kingshill and uncover the mysteries that are held in the depths of Castle Ravencaw. Adventurers - rise up to the challenge, defeat Sargon and earn great rewards during Drakensang Online’s Terrifying Shadows - A New Era event!

notes.title: Celebrate the Chinese New Year and challenge the Nian Beast!
notes.content:
The Nian Beast has arrived to consume all that was created in the past year. Battle it to defend the knowledge and the very nature of the world during Drakensang Online’s Chinese New Year event!

Complete tasks to earn vital rewards, including Firecrackers – the ideal ammo to scare away the vicious creature and save Duria once more!

notes.title: Uncover the mystery of the missing essences in the Desert of Essences event.
notes.content:
Few other substances in Dracania are more powerful than the precious essences sold by merchants. In an unforeseen twist, essence stocks seem to have run dry! What happened? Thabo, the realm magician, sends you to search for clues as to why the supply of essences has run out. All information you find leads you to the mysterious ruins in the desert of Shanri-La. 

In Shanri-La, mighty essence vortices raze everything in their path. They have their sights set on the essence merchants in particular, who are making their way to Shanri-Li to put an end to things. Could this mysterious guild be responsible for the shortage of supplies? And what have they done to invoke such scorn from the essence vortices?

Discover the answers to these mysteries in the Desert of Essences event!

notes.title: Play the Time of Solidarity event and take your group XP to a whole new level!
notes.content:
Insight is written in the stars for heroes of Dracania. For a limited time only, get more group experience by defeating the many ferocious monsters that terrify the inhabitants of Duria.

Play the Time of Solidarity event today and take advantage of this opportunity to take your group XP to a whole new level!

notes.title: Play the Riot of the Rocketmen event and celebrate the New Year!
notes.content:
Jullov has done it again! This time, he’s locked his uncle out of the laboratory and caused the machines there to malfunction. Save the Queen's firework festival and stop the chaos.

Play Drakensang Online’s Riot of the Rocketmen event and earn great rewards, including the Dracanian Rocket Mount and Jewel of Amplified Healing!

notes.title: Big Paws is back! Defeat him and save the Winter Solstice Festival!
notes.content:
Queen Antonia’s annual Winter Solstice Festival is about to be sabotaged, yet again, by Big Paws. 
The insatiable bear is a big fan of Queen Antonia’s Honey cookies and he will do anything possible to ruin the festive mood. Making things worse, the evil Kranparus, rival to Big Paws, has kidnapped the children of Kingshill! Travel with your hero to the Winter Summit to stop them both!

Successful heroes will be rewarded with a selection of unique gemstones and festive goodies. If this is not enough, the much talked about magical cave will offer adventurers something new every day of the winter calendar during the Winter Solstice Event!

notes.title: Enjoy HUGE savings in our Cyber Sale!
notes.content:
The Cyber Sale is here! Take advantage of massive savings on several exclusive packages! Enjoy incredible deals on must-have items including Gems, Jewels, Runes, Andermant and much, much more!

So, what are you waiting for, hero? Bag yourself a bargain in our amazing Cyber Sale today!

notes.title: Celebrate the Festive Thanksgiving and prepare for the coming of Winter!
notes.content: Are you ready for a big reward, hero! Then step into Drakensang Online’s Festive Thanksgiving across the lands and prepare to celebrate the coming of Winter. Now is the time to celebrate those brave souls who have driven the darkness back in these lands, of which you are one!

notes.title: The Ghost Festival has begun! Battle creepy monsters and save Duria once more!
notes.content:
For Oldfield it is the time of year to celebrate the yield of their beloved pumpkin fields by hosting their annual Ghost Festival. Everyone is in high spirits and ready to celebrate, until some sinister and haunting things start occurring in their usually peaceful village. Sophia, a village elder, seems to know more about these unsettling events and wants you to help her. In doing so, you might have to face horrendous events!

Are you brave enough to step into completely unknown lands filled with eerie ghosts and monsters? Take on the Return of the Dead challenge, win great rewards throughout the event and save Duria once again!

notes.title: Drakensang Online’s 12th Anniversary Festival has begun! Are you ready to fight?
notes.content:
Colorful banners are flying, fireworks brighten the sky, people are dancing everywhere – it can only mean one thing, the Dracanian Anniversary Festival is back! Visit Kingshill and take part in the greatest event in Dracania. 

But not everything is shining in the city! Some mysterious dark forces want to reintroduce the infamous Crystals of Truth into Dracania and spread chaos across the lands. What kind of sorcery is this? No one really knows; but one thing is sure: NPC Phestos is helping to defeat this evil plan. Bring all the Crystals of Truth you can find to him in Kingshill and get some incredible rewards in exchange!

Featuring new rewards, including new costumes, pets and mounts purchasable with pirate gold that you get from a new event map, where you can try your luck by cracking barrels, as well as new challenge events, there’s plenty to help you celebrate Drakensang Online’s 12th birthday event!

notes.content:

notes.title: Delve into the Infested Sewers of Kingshill and save the city from devastation!
notes.content:
Strange things are afoot in the Sewers below Kingshill. Workers are not coming home, the ground is shaking, heroes are missing, and to make matters worse, a Death Worm has been spotted. Kingshill is in dire need of help, and only you can help!

This won’t be an easy task. The sewers are dark and filled to the brim with danger. Scout reports indicate multiple dangerous foes roaming the dark tunnels – some even accompanied by big rats. Imagine taming those rats and travelling Dracania’s hidden paths! An enterprising adventurer could surely take advantage of that, and the craftsmen of Kingshill could even improve on such a mount. The sewers are also said to be full of ancient and powerful runes, just waiting to be claimed. 

Will you survive long enough to reach the Death Worm and put an end to the threat? Will Kingshill still be standing when you’re done? Team up with your friends or go in alone, and brave the Infested Sewers of Kingshill!

notes.title: Curse of the Immortals content update - out now!
notes.content:
The old scrolls tell of a time long past, where mighty immortals threatened to enslave the world until the races united under one banner and battled them back to the abyss. Yet now, the darkness stirs once more and with the world at war with itself, it needs a special hero to stand up to the fray!

This thrilling new content update features challenging new maps to uncover, including the Bastion of the Order city and the Greyling Forest, before entering the Primal Spark map for a grand battle against the fearsome, winged Paragon of Deceit. Other monstrosities drawn from the realms of the immortals are sent to terrorize the world, including: the unnerving Fiendish Slime, the ethereal Will-O'-the Wisp and the ferocious Ember Wolf.

But don’t despair, those brave enough to take on the challenge will be handsomely rewarded with powerful new items to equip their heroes, including the new Seeker’s Set. The Curse of the Immortals update also boasts new Rings, Runes and Jewels, a mysterious new Pet and much more!

Battle against the darkness and drive it back to whence it came in the Curse of the Immortals content update - the first iteration of Drakensang Online’s epic Immortal Saga. Break the Curse of the Immortals, earn riches galore and save Dracania from devastation once again!

notes.title: Stand strong and sacrifice yourself to the success of the Summer Solstice!
notes.content:
It’s summer and what better way to celebrate than with the annual Summer Solstice Festival! Preparations have begun to make this year’s festival the most memorable yet. Enter Kalodoro, earn Solar Coins in the mini-games and check out the special Summer Solstice offers. Will you collect enough Summer Solstice Tokens to open the chests of the Melon Pug and the Summer Solstice Horse?

Once the preparations are over and the Summer Solstice Festival has begun, it’s your duty to help ensure the festival is a success! Obtain Ferry Tickets from worthy enemies throughout Dracania, complete daily quests to earn Solar Coins and increase your helper rank by earning Insignias of Helpfulness. With tons of great rewards to claim, Drakensang Online’s Summer Solstice is an event you won’t want to miss!

notes.title: A new PvE Season has begun!
notes.content:
Prepare yourselves for a new PvE Season! Enter the 8 Parallel World maps and battle ferocious monsters and powerful bosses to earn your place on the leaderboards.

Finish in the top 100 and you’ll be rewarded with Chests, Materi Fragments and Andermant as well as exclusive Costumes and Mounts. There’ll also be exclusive emotes for players who reach the top 3!

The overall leaderboard is reserved for Dracania’s highest ranked players, with incredibly sought-after prizes, as well as bragging rights, the reward!

notes.title: Exclusive new event on the brand-new Harold server!
notes.content:
Adventurers, take this great chance to start your Drakensang legend from the very beginning and join our brand-new Harold server. Build up your heroes and resources to rise to the top of the rankings and challenge fellow warriors and magic wielders for glory on a level playing field.

But that’s not all! Take part in the Heroes Assemble event, exclusive to the brand-new Harold server, and earn useful items and valuable equipment to help you quickly boost up your hero right from the start – available for players up to level 55.

notes.title: Drakensang Online has officially launched on Steam!
notes.content:
Heroes of Duria!

We are thrilled to announce that Drakensang Online has left early access and has officially launched on Steam! After months of development and feedback from our dedicated community, we are extremely proud of this great achievement. We would like to thank all of our early access players for their support and feedback.

Look out for regular updates, new features and exciting offers over the coming weeks and months including a brand-new content expansion with numerous releases throughout the whole of 2023, and exclusive bundles and events to help new players level-up more quickly! Don't miss out on the full launch experience, play the game now on Steam and join the community today!
